mapper.select: SELECT u.id, r.code AS role, u.status, u.auth_version AS authVersion, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.is_active = 1 WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT id, password_hash AS passwordHash, status, auth_version AS authVersion, must_change_password AS mustChangePassword FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = 0, auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND auth_version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE users SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND auth_version = #{expectedVersion}
